raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions copies raw amounts without converting them, so the 85 EUR transactions are summed as if they were USD in every gold table. Converting each amount with raw_fx_rates.rate_to_usd in the silver step fixes all downstream gold tables, though the only available rate is dated 2026-01-01 and is applied to January transactions.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED';"}}
